description: V3LUM-authored supplement to the bundled CC0/MIT e-mail hygiene lists (P088 C1-C4). It is merged with the upstream lists at run time; the upstream files stay unmodified.

disposable.description: P088 C3: temp-mail provider domains missing from the CC0 disposable-email-domains list (coverage check of 2026-11-25/26).

free_providers.description: P088 C3: Brazilian webmail domains (also in the AfterShip list today, kept here so a refreshed upstream list cannot drop them) and the free providers of the former hard-coded email_basics FREE_PROVIDERS set (P088 C1: one set of data files).

relay.description: P088 C4: forwarding/alias privacy services. Tagged relay (privacy tool), never disposable and never scored as malicious, even when an upstream list names them disposable.
